title: Wet Signature vs Electronic Signature
dek: A wet signature is ink on paper; an electronic signature is a mark attached to a digital file. The medium is the whole difference — and it does not tell you which one your form accepts.

title: How to Fill Out a Form Someone Sent as a Photo
dek: A photo of a form is not a form. Here is the shortest route from a picture sitting in your messages to something you can type on and send back.

title: How to Reorder Pages in a Scanned Document
dek: Sheet feeders collate badly and duplex scans come out interleaved. Here is how to put a scan back in order, and what stays wrong afterwards.

title: The Five Things People Pay Acrobat For
dek: Most PDF tasks have a free answer that works. Five of them genuinely do not. Here is which is which, so you know what a subscription actually buys.

title: Why You Can't Type in That PDF Form
dek: There are three separate reasons a PDF refuses typed input, and each needs a different fix. Here is how to tell which one you have, in about a minute.

title: How to Black Out Information in a PDF (and What Redaction Really Means)
